newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' San Miguel reports weak 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' San Miguel reports weak 1996 results.

text.p: San Miguel Corp., the biggest brewery in the Philippines, reported weak but slightly better than expected financial results for 1996 Wednesday and said that it would post higher earnings this year.

The food and drink conglomerate, which also has operations in Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, Taiwan and Indonesia, said its net profit rose to 6.09 billion pesos ($231.6 million) from 5.84 billion pesos ($222.1 million), but added that the figures included one-time gains.
Net of one-time gains, earnings dropped to 5.26 billion pesos ($200 million) from 5.38 billion pesos ($204.6 million), a 2.0 percent fall.
Analysts said the figures were within forecasts or marginally better than expected.
"There were no surprises. The figures were generally within expectations," said Jonas Ferrer, vice president for research at Pryce Securities.
